Club pays for a coaching tool

BEPRO (Bepro Company Co., Ltd. / Bepro Europe GmbH)

Seoul, South Korea, with European entity in Hamburg and group entities in London · founded 2015 · active · bepro.ai · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolPortable unitDeployed in ItalyEvidence B€500 to €2,000 to start

A Korean-founded analysis company that sells a fixed or portable dual-lens 4K panoramic camera bundled with a cloud analysis suite, human-verified event data and optional video-based tracking data, aimed at academies and semi-professional clubs.

For Academies, semi-professional first teams and federations that already employ an analyst and want FIFA-qualified panoramic footage plus tagged event data delivered back within a day, with the option to add tracking-derived physical metrics without GPS vests. Fan streaming is a side benefit.

BEPRO exists because a Seoul team of analysts worked out in 2015 that the expensive part of football data was the human tagging, and that if you controlled the camera you could industrialise the tagging and sell it to clubs the big data houses ignored bepro-12, bepro-20. It matters now because the 2025 Cerberus OS3 release with RTMP live coding into Sportscode, the Camera Station that accepts any IP camera, and published dollar pricing for the portable kit mark a shift from bespoke fixed installs toward a self-serve product for smaller clubs bepro-10, bepro-09, bepro-02. It tells you that the analysis-first vendors are moving down market into the same academies that Veo and Pixellot serve from the streaming side, and that data delivered with the video, ahead of the camera itself, is where they intend to win.

Price band USD 2,000 one-off for the Cerberus portable camera plus USD 1,000 per year (or USD 83.33 per month) for BEPRO Space and Editor software, VAT excluded; fixed camera and event data services on quotation bepro-02

Italy BEPRO lists Italy among its office countries, has been the video analysis partner of the Divisione Calcio a 5 for Serie A futsal with a renewal announced in October 2024, and installed fixed cameras at Bologna FC's youth training grounds in December 2020 under an Italian business director bepro-08, bepro-15, bepro-16.

Products

  • Cerberus (BEPRO Portable Camera) (camera). Dual-lens 4K panoramic AI camera with swappable 4.5-hour batteries, on-device processing, WiFi control and RTMP output for live coding. bepro-02
  • BEPRO Fixed Camera and Camera Station (camera). Permanently installed panoramic camera with scheduled recording, plus a plug-and-play processing station that accepts any IP camera. bepro-05
  • BEPRO Quadpod (add-on). 7.6-metre aluminium four-legged stand weighing 6.5 kg with stabilisers and a wheeled backpack bag. bepro-03
  • BEPRO Space (platform). Cloud platform on web, mobile and tablet for schedules, video, data reports, library and team messaging. bepro-04
  • BEPRO Editor (app). Desktop editor with collaborative editing, live coding, custom view recording, tags and XML import. bepro-07
  • Standard, Advanced and Bespoke Data, Data API (add-on). Human-verified event data to FIFA definitions, video-tracking metrics without GPS, custom reports and API access. bepro-21

Scale, company-stated

More than 1,000 organisations per the homepage in September 2026 bepro-01; more than 2,400 teams across 50 nations per a November 2024 profile bepro-20; more than 500,000 matches analysed across 20 nations per the Divisione Calcio a 5 in October 2024 bepro-15; 184 two-hour recordings cited in the upload statistic bepro-02.
